text:
Alex: Heads-up: scheduling rolling soft reboots for az19 night window (Tue 02:00-06:00 UTC). We'll cycle one rack at a time, do a soft-reset of BMC + nvlink sanity checks, then run kv-cache prefix warmup. This should address the thermal drift and intermittent nvlink flaps we've seen over the last 3 weeks.
Maria: What's the attrition expectation (how many GPUs OOS at once)?
Alex: Plan: 1 rack (~16 GPUs) at a time per cohort, ~60m per rack including validations. Peak pool impact ~1-2% capacity loss depending on distribution. We'll hold a reserved burst pool (saturn-reserve) to absorb requests, not dropping traffic.
Phil: What about backfill? last time spot backfill spiked egress and caused tail latencies.
Alex: No spot backfill for this run. We'll use reserved burst + throttled evictions. Cost delta estimate: ~720 USD/day if we run full-night rotation; Maria please confirm cost center.
Jamie: Who's sending customer comms? SLA notices / banner?
Alex: Product will push a banner and email tomorrow AM. SEs will get heads-up. We'll publish a short maintenance note on status.redwood.ai with 30min updates.
ops-bot: Reminder: create maintenance ticket MAINT-2026-479 and attach runbook before 18:00 UTC today.
Maria: Rollback plan if BMC doesn't respond after soft-reset?
Alex: Rollback steps in runbook: 1) attempt ipmi soft-reset, 2) if unresponsive, power-cycle via ipmitool, 3) reassign tenant jobs to burst pool, 4) escalate to vendor. Canary rack will be first; if canary fails we abort.
Alex: ```
# quick rollback snippet
for host in $CANARY_HOSTS; do
  ipmitool -H $host -U admin -P "$IPMI_PASS" chassis power cycle || true
  sleep 30
done
```
Phil: Can we pre-seed the KV cache with heatmap to avoid regen storms? Throttled prewarm to avoid token surge.
Alex: Yes — we'll run prefix-cache seeder 15m after each rack cycle completes, rate-limited to 50 req/s.
Jamie: I'll add scheduled updates to the status page and set automated 30m posts.
SRE-Lead: Oncall ok with times, keep a hard pause threshold: if p95 generation > 1800ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows, pause the rotation and roll back. Notify SRE pager when that triggers.
Alex: Ack. Tagging @oncall and @support to watch metrics during run.
Maria: Approved cost charge for the reserved burst. :thumbsup:
Alex: Final runbook and checklist pushed to MAINT-2026-479. Canary starts Tue 01:45 UTC. I'll post the link in here when ticket is created.
Jamie: Thanks. We'll coordinate post-run verification with telemetry and the perf team.
Phil: One last ask — add a quick perf test step that hits 1% of traffic against the canary after warmup (low risk synthetic) to validate tail latencies.
Alex: Good call — adding synthetic smoke at T+30m.
Maria: Good to go from infra side.
ops-bot: MAINT-2026-479 created by Alex. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MAINT-2026-479
Alex: Link posted. Closing thread for prep, will reopen if issues during canary.
